stockOsAtLaunch: Android 14, with an Android 15 upgrade and 3 years of security updates committed by Motorola. This profile targets a device already updated to Android 15, per the supported v1 configuration.

citations.title: Motorola Moto G64 - GSMArena spec sheet

citations.title: Motorola G54/G64 5G Custom ROM Guide :: Cyber Knight
citations.note: Dedicated flashing-instructions page for the cancunf codename, authored by a recognized AOSP/GKI kernel developer. Confirms cancunf covers both the G54 5G and G64 5G, and that the page is scoped to Android-16-based ROMs built on Android 15 firmware. This exact host was blocked by this build environment's network egress policy (HTTP 403) and could not be fetched directly to extract verbatim commands -- a human must open it before real flashing is enabled.

citations.title: Cancunf_Stock_Flash_Guide (GitHub)
citations.note: Stock flash/relock guide for cancunf noting it is an MTK (MediaTek) device, and warning that flashing firmware below the device's fused anti-rollback (ARB) index can hard-brick it. Source of the EnforceAntiRollbackCheck=true flag on this profile.
